name: Denis Gruszkiewicz
role: Junior Data Scientist | Python, SQL, data pipelines and validation
summary: Student of Robotics and Process Automation (PWr) and IT systems (WSB Merito), with over a year in hospital IT support. In my own projects I work with data in Python and SQL: collecting it from external sources, validating it against schemas, storing it in PostgreSQL and Parquet, and checking results for leakage with walk-forward validation. I have no commercial data science experience yet and no formal statistics course beyond my engineering studies.
